name: How much does it cost to make a bathroom accessible in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to make a bathroom accessible in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of making a bathroom accessible in the East Bay area varies widely depending on the scope of work. Minor changes like grab bar installation or a raised toilet seat might be a few hundred dollars. Major renovations, such as converting to a roll-in shower, widening doorways, and reconfiguring the layout, can range from several thousands to tens of thousands of dollars. We provide detailed estimates after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary, from a few hundred dollars for minor changes to several thousands for major renovations.
